scope: Approved Conversation input, Browser presentation, shared document API, renderer import, and top-level Office-to-PDF ownership correction.

implementation.conversation: Moved InputBar and ContextMeter implementation and local styling from skeleton/ into input/; apply and tests now resolve the input owner.
implementation.browser: Moved BrowserBody, BrowserTitle, and their styling from view/ into browser/; the package index remains the registration and export owner.
implementation.document_preview: Moved TextPreview and text state/helpers into text/, retained the document contract, registry, tab-lifetime, and suffix helpers as top-level shared modules, and kept index.ts as the Office-to-PDF composition owner.
implementation.source_resolution: Removed cross-package runtime imports from ordinary src/* paths, added generated source-plane tsconfig aliases for repository tests/tooling, and documented that those aliases do not publish source exports.
implementation.generated_projection: Regenerated and verified the module-graph artifacts after the ownership moves.
